description: City partners with Quint to employ at-risk individuals.
Workers clean public spaces, remove graffiti, and pick up needles.
Project aims to reduce gang involvement and recidivism.

chips.text: Getting former gang members employed is an innovation compared to other Canadian projects.
Saskatoon is unique in Canada for addressing gangs through employment.
Public members express gratitude to workers for improving community safety.
Program supports individuals with significant criminal records and complex employment barriers.
Over 15 tons of waste and 3,308 needles removed from public spaces.
